spellbook.finance/limitations: Clearing an opening plan does not record receipt or physical opening, and it does not change a holding mark.
An existing marketplace listing remains unchanged. Read the listing preview and use spellbook_sealed_listing_pause when removal is needed.

description: Clear the plan to open every still-sealed unit in one purchase entry. Call this when spellbook_sealed_portfolio shows openIntentQuantity for stock the seller intends to keep sealed; then read the portfolio again. This preserves the units and any holding mark.

entryId.description: The exact purchase entryId from spellbook_sealed_portfolio. Required.

workspaceId.description: The workspace that owns the entry. Required.

name: spellbook_sealed_portfolio_open_intent_clear
